title: Savory Caesar Dip
description: Thick, cheesy, and briny all at once, this Caesar dip pairs the assertive garlicky anchovy flavor of Caesar dressing with the texture of a cream cheese-based dip. Scoop it up with crunchy vegetables, chips, or salty crackers.
instructions:
Place anchovies and garlic in a pile on a cutting board and sprinkle with salt. Roughly chop and mash the mixture with the side of a chef’s knife to form a paste, about 2 minutes. Transfer mixture to the base of a food processor and add the lemon juice, mustard and Worcestershire sauce and pulse until well combined.

Add the cream cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, and Parmesan and process until smooth, about 30 seconds. Scrape the edges and bottom of the bowl and blend until well combined, about 15 seconds.

Transfer the dip to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 24 hours. Stir before transferring dip to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh parsley, if desired. Serve with vegetables, lettuce and/or chips.

ingredients.raw: 4 anchovy fillets packed in oil, rinsed

ingredients.item: Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
ingredients.raw: 1/4 teaspoon Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume

ingredients.item: plain, full-fat cream cheese, softened, preferably Philadelphia brand
ingredients.raw: 8 ounces (225g) plain, full-fat cream cheese, softened, preferably Philadelphia brand
1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese (1 ounce; 25g)

ingredients.item: Chopped parsley for garnish, if desired
ingredients.raw: Chopped parsley for garnish, if desired

ingredients.item: Fresh cut vegetables, romaine lettuce wedges, chips
ingredients.raw: Fresh cut vegetables, romaine lettuce wedges, chips, or crackers for serving
